title: Decky Edition
description: Minecraft optimized and improved! to be playable on Steam Deck/Controller's.
body:
Decky Edition is a Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack built for handheld play, with a strong focus on Steam Deck and controller support.

The pack is designed to be playable out of the box, offering a comfortable and well-tuned controller setup that works naturally on portable devices. Everything can be customized, but the default layout is built around handheld ergonomics.

Key features:
- **Controller first experience**: with fully customizable bindings.
- **Optimized default controls**: designed specifically for handheld play.
- **Ingame resource pack downloader**: (no desktop mode required)
- **Ingame shader and map management**: for easy customization.
- **Vanilla+ visuals**: enhanced but performance-friendly.
- **Optional Steam Deck optimized shaders**: expected to run around 30–40 FPS with the included settings.
- **Many known vanilla issues fixed**: aiming to provide a more stable and polished experience.
- **Stable and lightweight**: focused on smooth gameplay rather than heavy overhauls.

**Visually** speaking, Decky Edition keeps the vanilla look while adding subtle improvements that feel right on smaller screens. Performance is always prioritized, and all visual features can be adjusted or disabled freely.

Decky Edition is built for players who want a portable, flexible, and comfortable Vanilla+ experience, without turning Minecraft into a complex modding project.
